# NBN 现场英语私有训练日志

**把复制后的日志放在私有笔记中，不要将填写后的客户经历、录音或内部信息提交公开仓库。** 这里的空白模板只记录虚构训练信息。未观察到的维度写 N/O，不填零来冒充失败。

## 单次记录：复制这段即可

```markdown
# NBN English / YYYY-MM-DD
Role: CFT / SFT / FE
Scenario: CFT-01（虚构）
Mode: quick-3 / standard-10 / challenge-20
Condition: voice or text / pace normal or fast / hints yes or no
Opening response without script: yes / no
Clarified an important point: yes / no / not observed
Explained impact and next action: yes / no / not observed
Repaired a misunderstanding: yes / no / not observed
Handover completed: yes / no
Specific strengths (2):
1.
2.
One high-impact fix:
My improved sentence (my own words):
Unexpected follow-up answered: yes / no
Score: clarification _/2; explanation _/2; boundaries _/2; repair _/2; handover _/2
Not observed categories: 
Risk flag: none / needs-review (why):
Next practice focus (ONE):
Next parallel test date:
Only abstract, fictional facts; no identifiers, raw customer recordings or work credentials.
```

**不要只记录总分。** 同样 8/10 可能掩盖“许诺了未确认恢复时间”的重大问题。先审风险标记，再比较相同条件下的任务表现。

**真实听众复述**仅在使用虚构或获许可内容的情况下进行。若没有真实听众，就标注 `AI roleplay only`，不要写成已证明客户理解。
